title: JsonException Psalm\Internal\Clause
body:
> Uncaught JsonException: Malformed UTF-8 characters, possibly incorrectly encoded in src/Psalm/Internal/Clause.php:124
https://github.com/vimeo/psalm/blob/0a81f8cd6cfb4d6db37b9d29c0e7b51d5af0f498/src/Psalm/Internal/Clause.php#L124

using `vimeo/psalm dev-master` (a0739b1), probably related to 0a81f8cd6cfb4d6db37b9d29c0e7b51d5af0f498

#### The payload of `$possibility_strings` at that time is

```
array(1) {
  ["$signature"]=>
  array(1) {
    [0]=>
    string(18) "!~string(��ࡱ�)"
  }
}
```

and the parsed file at that time was (similar to) https://github.com/PHPOffice/PHPExcel/blob/1.8.0/Classes/PHPExcel/Shared/OLE.php
